faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KFON District Telecom Executive post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application for the KFON District Telecom Executive post is 01 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the District Telecom Executive role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech degree in ECE/EEE/EIE with a minimum of 60% marks to be eligible for the District Telecom Executive position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the District Telecom Executive post is 40 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the District Telecom Executive position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month, along with an SLA Linked Incentive of Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the KFON District Telecom Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves multiple stages including Application Screening, Criteria-based Screening, Written Test, Group Discussion, Skill Test/Proficiency Test, and finally, an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of District Telecom Executive announced in this recruitment drive by Kerala Fibre Optic Network.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the KFON District Telecom Executive recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to fill out and submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The District Telecom Executive position is offered on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
